services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Explore art, history, science, and culture at the Whaling Museum through specially designed field trip experiences for students of all ages. Students can marvel at the whale skeletons, climb aboard the Lagoda whaling ship, and view the New Bedford harbor from the Observation Deck. Learn about whale adaptations, local history, immigration, literature, civics, and many other topics through themed tours and exhibit explorations. Extend your trip with additional learning activities like a squid dissection, 3-D movie, curator-led tour of a special exhibit, or visit to the Research Room.
